description: Address code review issues: suppress migration streaming callbacks, fix optimistic message XSS, add retry handler for failed messages, fix migration N+1 on media_attachments, add DmLink active icon, fix rake task Redis pooling.
steps: Fix migration worker to suppress after_create callbacks by using insert_all or suppressing callbacks during bulk creation
Fix optimistic message XSS by HTML-escaping content in the reducer before interpolation
Add retry click handler for failed messages in message_item.tsx
Add .includes(:media_attachments) to the status query in the migration worker
Add activeIcon prop to DmLink in navigation_panel/index.tsx following NotificationsLink pattern
Fix rake task migration_status to use Redisable concern instead of Redis.new
acceptance_criteria: Migration worker does not trigger streaming callbacks when creating messages
Optimistic message content is HTML-escaped before rendering
Failed messages have a clickable retry handler
Migration worker includes media_attachments in status query
DmLink has both icon and activeIcon props
Rake task uses proper Redis pooling via Redisable
ruby -c passes on all modified Ruby files
findings: All 6 review issues addressed. Used attr_accessor :skip_side_effects with conditional callbacks (unless: :skip_side_effects) instead of Rails suppress_callbacks which does not exist. The rake task uses an anonymous class including Redisable to access the redis method. TypeScript compiles cleanly. Ruby syntax checks pass. Issues #3 (unread cache race) and #6 (permanent Redis key) documented as acceptable tradeoffs per reviewer instructions - no code changes made for those.
